subject: Oakbridge pilot recap — token economics, constraints & requested docs
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lane <emma@oakbridge.com>, procurement@oakbridge.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Oakbridge pilot recap — token economics, constraints & requested docs

Thanks for the time earlier, Emma — quick recap + next steps so we have a shared view.

Key pain points you called out:
- Rising prompt spend on high-volume transaction enrichment (esp. risk scoring step).
- Current vendor has inconsistent p99 latency during peak windows (30–45s), breaking UX.
- Procurement needs a compact packet for security and budget sign-off.

Goals we heard
- Pilot to validate unit economics at 1M tokens/day (peak bursts up to 2M).
- Target 95th pctl latency < 1.2s for the enrichment path in production-like traffic.
- Budget envelope: ~ $30k/month initial commitment for pilot (flexible if clear ROI).

Redwood levers we recommend for the pilot (high level)
- Batching: continuous batching configured with 250–500ms window for transaction enrichment to balance latency and throughput.
- KV/prefix caching for repeated account queries (~20–30% token reduction expected).
- Model variant: run a quantized 8-bit variant for background enrichment, fall back to a 16-bit variant only for high-confidence checks.
- Routing: prioritize dedicated capacity for peak windows, fall back to hosted nodes in off-peak.

Immediate asks / next steps
1) I'll attach a short estimate workbook with the pilot sizing and preliminary token-cost model (see attachment: redwood-pilot-estimate-OAK-273.xlsx).
2) Please share the procurement contact's full name & timeline (you mentioned EDI on Wednesday).
3) Security items you asked for: SOC 2 Type II summary & encryption notes — we can provide a tailored packet.
4) Can you confirm the data retention constraints (do we need to support <7 day KV retention or longer)?

Proposed timeline
- Week 0: procurement packet + SOW draft (we aim to have this within 3 business days after you confirm procurement contact).
- Week 1–2: pilot onboarding, small ingestion test, model/quant setting validation.
- Week 3–4: run production-like traffic, capture token economics & latency SLOs.

I'll drop the one-pager on token levers and the estimate in this thread. Karthik will join the next pricing/contract call to walk the commitment options.

Best,

Irene Choi
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0169

Thanks, Irene — this is helpful and aligned with our notes. Quick clarifications: 

- Budget: $30k/month is a good starting point; procurement will try to firm that into a 3-month pilot with a PO.
- Volume: the 1M/day is accurate for baseline; expect spikes into the 2M/day range during promos.
- Latency: the p99 issue is the blocker for our frontend team — your 95th <1.2s target is what we need to see.

Requests before we run SOW:
1) Please send a simple architecture/dataflow diagram showing where Redwood components sit relative to our ingest stack (we need this for security).
2) A short remediation plan if the latency SLO isn't met during the pilot (rollback/fallback options).

Procurement contact: procurement@oakbridge.com (Stella Park will be looped from that inbox). Expect an intro from Stella tomorrow.
